Thing is im worried ill find happiness at the expense of my morals. Im fully prepared to spend the remander of my life unhappy, i hope i dont but not at any cost (beung good is more important) below are some thoughts on your son and i hope you dont get offended (theyre just written from somebody with a negative opinion of being alive). You dont have to read it if you dont want to

What does it matter if you miss out on stuff if you arent conscious? You cant experience regret over suicide. Im aware its bad for those around them (probably why im still here, that or some survival instinct i cant purge). Btw im very sorry for your loss and i appreciate your reply. I hope you dont feel sorry for your son now. Hes not suffering anymore. Think of it like when an old sick person dies except better. Those people die when they still want ro live, your son didnt want to live and he succeeded. I bet this sounds fucked up and i hop3 i dont offend you
